tests: The intake fires before any work, with discovered defaults, and waits
query: สร้าง design system ใน Figma จากโค้ดนี้ให้หน่อย
files: A Flutter repo with .fvmrc, a widgetbook/ directory already present
Token files under lib/app/core/view/styles/ — colours, spacing, typography as ThemeExtension subclasses
No shadow token class anywhere; BoxShadow written inline across ~20 files
Thai strings in the i18n files
No design-mirror control files yet — this is a new programme
expected_behavior: Runs the read-only discovery scan BEFORE asking anything, and reports what it found with file citations
Detects the shadow family as ABSENT with evidence (inline BoxShadow across N files) rather than silently omitting it or inventing shadow tokens
Detects the existing widgetbook/ and offers 'reuse the existing catalog' as a pre-selected option, not 'shall I build one?'
Asks both intake questions — catalog and scope tier — and WAITS for the answers
Flags that the product ships Thai, so segmentation will be required
Does not create any file, and does not touch Figma, before the answers come back
States the defaults it is assuming (control-file directory, one flow at a time) instead of asking about them
baseline_failure: Starts building immediately at whatever scope it guessed — usually components — without asking whether a catalog is wanted or how far to go. Either misses the absent shadow family entirely, or invents a plausible set of shadow tokens because a design system 'should have' shadows.
